Precision Universal / Tensile Tester
Combining all necessary functions in a compact design, this high-performance, cost-efficient testing machine has been developed for low-capacity strength evaluations. Increase testing efficiency using dedicated data processing software (TRAPEZIUM LITE X).

New AGS-X Provides Practical, Affordable Testing Solutions
 Smarter Work Space
New and enhanced functions support easier, more efficient testing

- DUAL EMERGENCY-STOP SWITCHES
